description:
My name is Walt Brennan. Thirty-two years I pulled wire and read meters for the same utility that mails you the bill.

I've been inside more walls than I can count, and I've stood in enough burned-out bedrooms to know most of them started with a three-dollar part nobody looked at.

This channel is what I saw in those walls. Plain talk, real numbers, no upsell. What it costs at the store, what it costs if you leave it, and the one question to ask before anybody sells you a new panel.

Tell me what year your house was built. I read every comment.
